ends.note: dead end inside the block; buildings close the alley about 130 ft north of 5th

notes: Block Main-Sycamore, 6th-5th. THOMAS ALLEY (10') runs from 6th south to Cuts Alley (T at both ends). LANGDON ALLEY (no width printed, about 12-20 ft; east edge partly covered by paste-overs, centre taken at x~2042 from the labels and west edge) runs from 6th to a dead end at y~2645; north of 6th an unnamed alley (block on sheet 133, centre x~2064) continues it with a ~20 px jog, so Langdon/6th is recorded as a cross at the mean x. CUTS ALLEY (printed CUTS ALLEY east of Langdon, 10') runs from Thomas Alley to Sycamore; its north side steps ~12 px at Langdon. LUDLOW (printed LUDLOW, with a vertical ALLEY nearby) is a narrow open strip (about 4-10 ft) between the buildings from Langdon Alley to Sycamore at y~2470-2504; recorded as Ludlow Alley but it is little more than a passage. A 'PRIVATE' passage label below it is not recorded. Government Place (sheet 120) meets Main from the west at y~2311. At Main/5th the street west of Main is GOVERNMENT SQ. (130', axis y~3218, south edge y~3444), east of Main E. 5TH (66', axis y~3110): two T's. An unnamed alley (~10 ft, printed only ALLEY on sheet 122) enters 5th from the south at x~1911; only its north end is on this sheet, recorded under alleys.
